title: Sales Representative
description:
We are seeking an experienced Sales Executive specialized in food ingredients sales to lead business development across Ernakulam and Kozhikode region ..

**Seeking candidates only from Kerala** .

Key Responsibilities

· Develop and implement regional sales strategies for food ingredients in alignment with company goals.

· Identify and acquire new clients in food processing, bakery, dairy, beverage, and spice industries across Kerala and South India.

· Maintain excellent relationships with existing customers and ensure timely follow-up on sales orders and product feedback.

· Conduct regular market visits to identify emerging trends, customer needs, and competitor activities.

· Coordinate with the marketing, R&D, and production teams to address client requirements related to ingredient specifications, testing, or customization.

· Achieve monthly and annual sales targets with consistent performance monitoring and reporting.

· Prepare and deliver professional sales presentations, proposals, and quotations.

· Analyze market performance and share periodic sales reports with management.

· Participate in exhibitions, trade shows, and promotional events to enhance brand visibility.

· Ensure proper payment collection, documentation, and credit management in coordination with accounts.

Required Skills and Qualifications

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Marketing, or Business Administration.

· Minimum 0-2 years of experience in food ingredient sales or FMCG B2B marketing.

· Strong understanding of food ingredient functionality, product application, and formulation support.

· Excellent communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.

· Proven ability to plan, manage, and execute regional sales strategies.

· Proficient in MS Office, CRM tools, and sales reporting techniques.

· Ability to travel extensively across Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Andhra Pradesh.

Compensation and Benefits

· Fixed Salary(minimum ): ₹20,000 per month (based on experience and qualification).

· Incentive Structure: Attractive performance-based incentives linked to quarterly and annual targets.

· Additional Perks: Travel allowance, mobile allowance, and annual performance bonus.

· Opportunity for professional growth and leadership advancement within the organization.

*Preferred Qualities*

· Strong interpersonal ability to build long-term customer trust.

· Self-driven with a passion for achieving excellence in food ingredient sales.

· Analytical and strategic thinker with adaptability to dynamic market trends.

· Commitment to maintaining high ethical and professional standards in all business dealings.

title: Sales Manager DSA
description:
Hiring: DSA Sales Manager – Home Loans

Location: kottayam , Kerala

Department : Sales – Home Loans

Experience : Minimum 2 years in team handling

Industry : Banking / Housing Finance / NBFC

Job Description

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented DSA Sales Manager – Home Loans to lead and manage the sales team in kottayam. The ideal candidate should have a strong background in home loan sales, DSA channel development, team management, and customer acquisition.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead, manage, and motivate a team of DSA sales executives to achieve home loan business targets.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with DSA partners, builders, real estate agents, connectors, and other referral sources.
* Generate quality home loan leads and drive business growth through the DSA channel.
* Identify new business opportunities and expand the DSA network across calicut and surrounding areas.
* Monitor team performance, sales productivity, lead conversion, and monthly disbursement targets.
* Coordinate with credit, operations, legal, and technical teams to ensure smooth loan processing and timely disbursement.
* Ensure proper documentation, customer service, and compliance with company policies.
* Conduct regular team meetings, sales reviews, and market visits to improve productivity.
* Prepare sales reports, track the sales pipeline, and implement strategies to achieve business goals.

Eligibility Criteria

* Minimum 2 years of team handling experience in sales.
* Experience in home loans, LAP, housing finance, banking.
* Strong understanding of DSA sales, lead generation, and loan sourcing.
* Proven ability to manage sales teams and achieve business targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-management skills.
* Must be willing to work in the kottayam location.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience and suitability.
* Performance-based incentives.
* Opportunity to grow in the banking and housing finance industry.
* A target-driven and professional work environment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resume through direct message or email, mentioning “DSA Sales Manager – kottayam” in the subject line.
